message: Verdant 15.4.7 fixes the V15.4.6 Editor/runtime clock type mismatch by using a brand-new clock controller class, filename and Unity GUID.
notes: Uses a new runtime script filename and GUID so Unity/UdonSharp cannot resolve the installer against the stale old class definition.
Retains the independent Verdant.Menu diagnostics assembly.
Retains the proper Runtime/Editor asmdefs, UdonSharp registration and VerdantRoleAuthority.
Keeps supporter scrolling, 12/24-hour dropdown/toggle handling and version-label repair.
